bootstrap_protocol.aggregation: pooled windows/events/exposure, not mean of per-run rates
bootstrap_protocol.ap: non-interpolated, tied scores grouped; whole-run multiplicity weights
bootstrap_protocol.minimum_runs: partition >=2 runs; per-fault-type >=2 contributing runs; point retained
bootstrap_protocol.order: sort partitions and run IDs lexicographically before sampling
bootstrap_protocol.pairing: same run multiplicities for all detectors, metrics and fault types
bootstrap_protocol.sampling: uniform n-out-of-n whole runs with replacement, separately per partition
bootstrap_protocol.scope: conditional on saved models, preprocessing, cutoffs and finite run collection
bootstrap_protocol.undefined: exclude per metric; no redraw or zero substitution; report valid/undefined

limitations: Models, preprocessing, cutoffs, ID/OOD memberships, bootstrap seed and repetitions were reused without selection.
Hashes verify integrity/compatibility, not authenticity or historical proof that test was observed only once.
The finite synthetic collection provides no broad operating-regime or real-CAN generalization guarantee.
Normal OOD false alarms are reported alongside detection; weak/negative results are valid scientific outcomes.
Few contributing runs cause undefined/suppressed or degenerate confidence intervals; resampling adds no new data.
Intervals condition on fitted models and selected validation cutoffs; training/selection uncertainty is excluded.
Latency conditions on detected events; inspect misses and censoring with every latency summary.
Runtime evidence is historical and machine/session specific; it is not CAN-to-alert latency or a timing regression gate.
Live inference, UI, affected-message attribution and final V2 acceptance belong to later work. No release is implied.

identity_bridge.policy: content equivalence; separate experiment/split/run identities remain distinct

runtime.verification: historical artifact integrity and metric arithmetic; no new timing or scoring

workload.ordering: first N eligible ID windows in saved row order; no shuffle

scope: frozen synthetic experiment software; no generalization or real-vehicle acceptance
